description: This is a Java unit test source file for testing the {@link ThingModifyCommandResponseAdapter} class. It contains numerous test cases verifying conversion between different representations of thing modification responses within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including adaptations from and to 'Adaptable' objects, covering create, modify, delete, and specific attribute operation responses.

classes.name: ThingModifyCommandResponseAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for {@link ThingModifyCommandResponseAdapter}, verifying conversion logic between Adaptable objects and response symbols for different modify operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test, creating an instance of {@link ThingModifyCommandResponseAdapter}.
